name: godot
description: The engine's words (#433, #2054): MeshInstance3D with a BoxMesh, OmniLight3D and SpotLight3D in physical units, each with its stated conversion, a light's range in metres onto ours. A word with no mapping is refused.

MeshInstance3D.conversion: BoxMesh to slab@1; rotation YXZ radians through the matrix to ours

OmniLight3D.conversion: light_intensity_lumens kept; omni_range in m onto range, 5 m unwritten as the engine's; omni_attenuation 2 only (the inverse square), unwritten 2: the engine's default of 1 is not drawn

SpotLight3D.conversion: light_intensity_lumens kept (the engine's spot counts the whole sphere, as ours); spot_angle the outer half angle; spot_range in m onto range, 5 m unwritten as the engine's; spot_attenuation 2 only (the inverse square), unwritten 2: the engine's default of 1 is not drawn
